headline: 开源游戏代理一天涨超千星，把Claude Code与Codex接到从构想到发行的游戏流水线。
headlineEn: An open-source game agent adds over a thousand stars in a day, wiring Claude Code and Codex into a pipeline from idea to store listing.

lead.name: nexu-io/opengame
lead.zh: 把二十多个编程代理接成全栈游戏工作室，可改一百多个可玩模板并发行到微信、抖音、TikTok等渠道。
lead.en: Turns twenty-plus coding agents into a full-stack game studio, remixing a hundred-plus playable titles and publishing to WeChat, Douyin, TikTok and other channels.
lead.why: 每天用编程代理写代码的人，可以把同一套代理接到游戏制作和发行链路上，该仓库一天新增一千一百三十三星。
lead.whyEn: People who already live in coding agents can point those same agents at game production and publishing; the repo gained 1,133 stars in a day.

sections.title: 技能包、会话蒸馏与模拟器并行测试
sections.titleEn: Skill packs, session distillation, and parallel simulator tests

items.name: addyosmani/agent-skills
items.zh: 面向编程代理的工程技能包，覆盖从定义到发布各阶段的质量门禁。
items.en: Packs the workflows and quality gates senior engineers use, so coding agents apply them from spec through release.

items.name: sybil-solutions/skill-distill
items.zh: 在一次跑通的Claude Code或Codex会话结束时，把步骤蒸馏成开源权重模型可跟随的技能。
items.en: After a strong Claude Code or Codex session, freeze the method into a skill a smaller open-weight model can rerun.

items.name: pierridotite/mobile-agent-testers
items.zh: 用免费的GitHub Runner并行拉起二十个Claude Code测试员，分别进不同手机查流程与无障碍问题。
items.en: Runs twenty Claude Code testers in parallel on free GitHub runners, each on a different phone image, looking for broken flows, copy, layout and accessibility issues.

items.name: Pushary Calls
items.zh: 错过AI代理的提醒时，它会打电话给你。
items.en: When an agent ping goes unseen, it places a phone call.

sections.title: 热路径迁到Rust与纯汇编推理
sections.titleEn: Hot-path ports to Rust, and inference in pure assembly

items.name: erkamyaman/rust-anything
items.zh: 按模块把应用迁到Rust，每一步都对照原程序是否仍表现一致。
items.en: Move an app to Rust in slices, verifying behavior against the original after each step, for many mainstream languages.

items.name: EL4CTEO/fast-anything
items.zh: 作者称先剖析再只改约百分之五的慢函数，交给编程代理移植到Rust并核对结果。
items.en: Profile first, then have a coding agent port only the slow slice to Rust and prove the outputs match recorded calls.

items.name: alesha-pro/llm.asm
items.zh: 用纯x86-64汇编写出可引导系统和Qwen3-0.6B推理，不含C与libc。
items.en: Hand-written x86-64 assembly for Qwen3-0.6B inference, a bootable OS, and a tiny trainer, with no C and no libc.

items.name: gpyou
items.zh: 在现货里找最便宜的GPU算力，做法类似计算版OpenRouter。
items.en: Routes jobs to the lowest-priced GPUs currently listed, in the same spirit as OpenRouter.

sections.title: 浏览器改Office、划词提问与代理用人物检索
sections.titleEn: Browser Office editing, clip-to-model queries, and people search for agents

items.name: XinaTian/MROffice
items.zh: 浏览器里编辑文档、表格、演示文稿和PDF，并经MCP让Claude与ChatGPT改真实Office文件。
items.en: In-browser editors for documents, spreadsheets, decks, PDF and code, with MCP so Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Codex can create and edit real Office files.

items.name: snibl
items.zh: 从任意应用划存文本，再拿去问AI。
items.en: Keep text you highlight in any app, then query a model about those clips.

items.name: Ploid
items.zh: 给AI代理做人物检索，覆盖二十亿以上档案。
items.en: A people-search layer for agents, spanning more than two billion profiles.
